rows.en: No... how could this happen...
rows.notes: Transcript "sonna konna koto tte" read as "sonna, konna koto tte".

rows.en: Honestly, what are you doing!?
Amazing. That's a pro for you.
Looks like your skills are the real deal.
What is this?
No way! Why now, at such an important time!?
Don't tell me... the Vajra are after this place...
OK! You don't have to tell me!
Thank you. I got to sing my heart out.
Alto, Ranka means to make herself the decoy!
Let's go, Ranka!
Hold the L button and press the R button to release the lock-on.
I'll explain the Special Maneuvers for you.
You've reached the target area. That's it for Special Maneuvers training.
Training time's up. That's it for Special Maneuvers training.
From here on, Sheryl Nome...
rows.notes: Continues in Ranka 1105 "...and Ranka Lee will walk you through the controls together!"

rows.en: That covers the basics of Special Maneuvers 3.
That covers the basics of Special Maneuvers.
Sorry, Ranka. My work here is done. I can't explain anything. Nothing...
rows.notes: Odd line in the tutorial banter; translated as heard. Context unclear.

rows.en: Ranka...
Ranka, explanations can't save the galaxy.
Oh, fine. Let's go, Ranka.
First up: Charge Guard. The moment you input it, enemy attacks can't hit you for a while.
rows.notes: "Charge Guard" not in the glossary; alternate take of 1112 (Charge Break).

rows.en: First up: Charge Break. The moment you input it, enemy attacks can't hit you for a while.
While you're invincible, an aura appears around your unit, so it's easy to tell.
rows.notes: Transcript "jiki" in the wrong kanji (period); meant own unit.

rows.en: That's not all. When it ends, your SP Gauge is gone and you can't use any moves that need it.
So you can only use Charge Guard once per mission.
rows.notes: "Charge Guard" not in the glossary; alternate take of 1116.

rows.en: So you can only use Charge Break once per mission.
It's handy when you really need to break out of an enemy combo.
Next, I'll explain Single Lock.
With multi-lock special weapons, hold L and keep holding Circle to lock on to your current target several times, not several targets.
It uses the same buttons as the old Charge Shot. Charge Shot is gone this time.
...and to focus your fire on one target, switching to Single Lock might be best.
The lock-on cursor changes during Plus Lock, so keep an eye on it.
Combine it with Single Lock and you could deal heavy damage.
That covers the new Special Maneuvers and the changed controls.
Alto...
You tried to understand as best you could. And all I did was explain.
rows.notes: Transcript reads oddly; translated as heard. Comes after Ranka 1125-1126 calling Sheryl, who was lost in thought (1125 "Alto...").

rows.en: I said I'll explain it again, so listen properly this time. I rarely do this kind of service.
rows.notes: Matches the in-game note that missed explanations can be replayed.

rows.en: Now I know I can just explain it again, too.
rows.notes: Literal: "because I also understood that I just have to explain once more". Context unclear.

rows.en: With SP Gauge to spare, hold the L and R buttons and press Triangle to use Charge Guard.
rows.notes: "Charge Guard" not in the glossary; alternate take of 1130.

rows.en: With SP Gauge to spare, hold the L and R buttons and press Triangle to use Charge Break.
Now that it's come to this, I'll go all the way!
Sounds interesting! I'll lend a hand!
Let me cover the story! Please!
I'll get footage that'll have the viewers crying with joy!
My report is going to end this battle.
Telling the truth: that's my job as a journalist.
Great! Photo op!
I'll get a beautiful shot! Go get 'em!
Show me how cool you can be!
That's way too reckless!
Keep this up and you'll get shot down.
No need to charge in. I'll get a good shot of you anyway.
Damn! What are you doing!?
No... an ally got taken out...
You think viewers want to see a scene like this!?
Reinforcements, right on cue! The crowd will love this!
Reinforcements are here! This should turn the tide!
Looks like friendlies came to help us.
I want everyone to know the truth about this.
I'll change the world with this huge scoop!
I just did my job as a newsman.
Yahoo!
Just watch! I'll knock your socks off!
We've still got an ace up our sleeve!
Okay.
OK!
I just have to do it, right?
Don't forget you're my subject, Captain!
rows.notes: hishatai: the person he is filming.

rows.en: Take this a little more seriously, Captain!
Captain, you okay?
What good is it if the Captain gets shot down!?
This is no joke!
I don't want a scoop like this!
I can use this shot!
Got it all on camera.
Way to go, Silvie!
This is a real scoop!
